verdict.summary_en: Boise Semiconductor order acknowledgement OA26134666 for Soony Interactive GmbH's PO 4500318736 of 2026-09-15. It confirms two lines of CMP-GAM-002 (Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5) at 6.11 USD each: 5,000 pcs confirmed for 2026-10-21 and 6,000 pcs confirmed for 2026-10-20. The terms are EXW Boise with NET30 payment. The terms text also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice.
red_flags: The terms contradict each other: EXW Boise (buyer normally arranges freight) is stated together with 'Freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice'. This adds costs to the invoice that EXW would not normally include. DDP is stated as not agreed.
The same material appears on two lines with different confirmed dates (5,000 on 2026-10-21, 6,000 on 2026-10-20). The later date is on the earlier line item.
The document gives no ordered quantity, so the confirmed quantity (11,000 in total) cannot be checked against the PO from this document alone.
The document has no issue date. The only date besides the confirmed dates is the PO date, 2026-09-15.
observations: Clean, printed, single-page document with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The Qty column is not labelled as ordered or confirmed. It is read as the confirmed quantity because this is an order acknowledgement.
